items.title: Intuit (INTU) Expands IDEAS Accelerator With LA28 Olympics Cohort
items.summary: Intuit (NasdaqGS:INTU) expanded its AI-powered IDEAS accelerator with a new LA28 Olympics cohort focused on small business procurement opportunities. The LA28 cohort aims to help local and veteran-owned businesses pursue supplier and contractor roles tied to the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games in Los Angeles.
